codeReview.summary: The fix adequately addresses all 4 original blocking issues from the prior review. The component now uses offline-aware mutations (useCreateVista, useCreateVisitasFromGroup, useUpdateVista) from the use-visitas hook instead of direct API calls. handleGenerateSale now includes isOnline() check with user feedback. The direct API functions (createVista, bulkCreateVisitas, updateVistaStatus) have been removed.

issues.description: handleGenerateSale shows toast.info when offline but still attempts the mutation which will fail. Should either return after the toast or use offline-aware mutation. However, the error is handled gracefully via try/catch with showError, so this is non-blocking.

summary: PASS: The fix adequately addresses all 4 original blocking issues. Issues #1-3 are fully resolved - the component now uses offline-aware mutations from use-visitas.ts (useCreateVista, useCreateVisitasFromGroup, useUpdateVista) instead of direct API calls. Issue #4 is partially resolved - handleGenerateSale now has isOnline() check with user feedback message, and errors are handled gracefully. One minor non-blocking issue: handleGenerateSale continues to attempt the API call when offline (which fails), but this is handled gracefully with error feedback.
